name: 3D Printing Holes
description: Holes made for 3D printing. Teardrop: select sketch circles, then run it; each gets a small tip a few percent of the diameter above it (it follows the diameter), so the top of a horizontal hole does not sag.

apply_to_all.title: Apply to all circles in sketch
apply_to_all.description: Off: convert only the selected sketch circles. On: convert every (non-construction) circle of the open sketch, no selection needed.

up.title: Tip direction
up.description: Where the tip points. world +Z (print up) = world +Z projected into the sketch plane, the usual print direction; sketch +X / -X / +Y / -Y = the sketch's own axes.

warn_horizontal.title: Warn on horizontal sketch
warn_horizontal.description: With Tip direction = world +Z on a horizontal sketch, world +Z gives no direction and the tip points to sketch +Y. Warn about it (turn off when the part prints in another orientation anyway).

tip_extra_d.title: Tip above circle (% of Ø)
tip_extra_d.description: How far the tip rises above the circle, in percent of the diameter: the hole gets this many percent of its diameter taller at the top. A few percent bridge the sagging top of a printed hole.

tip_height.title: Override: tip from centre
tip_height.description: Empty: the tip comes from Tip above circle (% of Ø). Set: replaces it with this distance from the centre (not from the circle) to the tip, in mm or an expression where r is the radius and d the diameter, e.g. d/2 + 0.3 mm, or d*sqrt(2)/2 for a classic 45 deg teardrop.
